bank_upgrade.title: National Bank of Amman - Core Network Upgrade
bank_upgrade.challenge: Replacing legacy switching fabrics and firewalls across 45 branches without interrupting live retail banking transactions.
bank_upgrade.solution: Designed and deployed an active-active SD-WAN backbone using Fortinet Next-Gen firewalls, combined with a zero-downtime traffic rerouting sequence.
bank_upgrade.outcome: Improved multi-branch secure database sync speeds by 300% while maintaining absolute compliance with local central bank security directives.

health_cloud.title: Ministry of Health - High-Availability Private Cloud
health_cloud.challenge: Consolidating patient records from 12 regional hospital clusters into a secure, centralized portal accessible under heavy load.
health_cloud.solution: Built a hybrid virtualization cluster using VMware and Dell PowerEdge servers, protected by robust data replication and active-active failover zones.
health_cloud.outcome: Centralized patient database access with 99.999% proven uptime, lowering administrative overhead and enhancing secure medical diagnostic sharing.

industrial_scada.title: Gulf Refining Facility - OT/SCADA Network Security
industrial_scada.challenge: Protecting operational technology (OT) monitoring systems from external internet cyber threats while enabling remote diagnostics.
industrial_scada.solution: Imposed strict network segmentation using Palo Alto Networks industrial firewalls and data diodes, establishing an isolated demilitarized zone (DMZ).
industrial_scada.outcome: Eliminated unauthorized access vectors into critical industrial controllers, allowing secure read-only diagnostic exports for engineering crews.
